Solxce uses your location in the background and foreground to accurately track your outdoor run routes, distance, splits, elevation, and live GPS telemetry.
Solxce requires location access to map your outdoor running paths, track real-time pace, and calculate workout distance.
Solxce requires continuous background location access to map and record your long-distance running workouts even when your phone is locked.
Solxce uses your camera to scan meals for instant AI macro nutrition logging and capture workout progress media.
Solxce uses your microphone to record audio with your workout video reels and capture voice notes for coaching logs.
Solxce accesses your photo library so you can select and share workout photos and video reels with the community.
Solxce saves exported workout summaries, progress milestone graphics, and running route recap cards to your photo library.
Solxce reads your heart rate, active energy burned, resting metabolic rate, and step counts to provide personalized athletic coaching and live telemetry.
Solxce writes completed workouts, running sessions, and nutritional intake data to Apple Health.
Solxce uses motion and pedometer data to measure running cadence, step frequency, and live athletic activity metrics.
Solxce connects to Bluetooth heart rate monitors, smart fitness sensors, and athletic wearables during workouts.
Solxce discovers and pairs with Bluetooth fitness accessories and chest strap heart rate monitors.
Solxce syncs your planned training sessions and athletic workouts directly to your personal calendar.
Solxce requires calendar access to schedule, modify, and synchronize your upcoming workout events.
Solxce sets reminders for your scheduled training runs, workout sessions, and daily hydration goals.
Solxce manages training reminders and daily habit checklists across your devices.
Solxce accesses Apple Music so you can attach soundtrack cues and preview motivational tracks during workouts.
Solxce uses Face ID to securely authenticate your profile and protect private workout and health telemetry.
Solxce uses speech recognition to transcribe voice coaching commands and spoken workout logs hands-free.
